chunks: Do they not realize that God, who created the heavens and the earth and did not tire of creating them, is able to bring the dead to life? Yes, indeed, He has power over everything.
ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic argument for the Resurrection based on Creation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the physical resurrection (Ba'th al-Jasad), arguing that the Creator who effortlessly fashioned the cosmos is equally capable of reassembling scattered remains. It underscores the attribute of Divine Power (Qudrah) as the primary evidence against those who doubted the possibility of returning to life after death.
